title: Aurora Teal · Terminal dashboard theme
description: Green → teal → blue appearance CSS with reduced-motion support. No personal background, hosted font or dashboard layout is bundled. Back up your existing board CSS before applying. Setup: see this package's INSTALL.md in the public source release. Add an approved public source URL before submitting. Configure actual service URLs and credentials locally after import; never upload them to Workshop.
changelog: Initial public release; portable example URLs and documented local setup.
